html: <sherpa-overlay-panel data-heading="Ada Lovelace" data-icon="person" data-dismissible data-collapsible data-expandable>
use: For a quick peek while the page behind stays live: no scrim, no focus trap, and one panel at a time. For a fixed panel beside the Context, use a `sherpa-app-shell` panel area; for a task that blocks the page, use `sherpa-dialog`.
